notes:
⚠️ IMPORTANT: This site requires special handling:
1. Bot Protection: Returns 403 Forbidden on automated requests - requires Playwright/Selenium with proper headers and user-agent
2. Partially JS-rendered: Listings appear in initial HTML but may dynamically load with pagination
3. Real Estate Site: This is a residential real estate site (NOT business-for-sale listings)
4. Listing Count: Page shows "100 out of 420 Results" with pagination
5. Image URLs: Available in both data-lazy attribute and style background-image
6. Link Format: Relative URLs like "./details/115524018/418-college-ave-san-francisco-ca-94112"
7. Property IDs: Available in @target attribute of the link wrapper
8. Status Badges: "New" and likely other statuses in .banner span elements

SELECTORS IDENTIFIED (not fully tested due to 403 blocks):
- Container: a.prop-link (wraps each property card)
- Alternative: article.prop-card (the actual card element)
- Image: .image-area .image with @data-lazy or @style extraction
- Details section: .prop-detail contains address, price, beds, baths, sqft

RECOMMENDED IMPLEMENTATION:
- Use Playwright with stealth mode and proper headers
- Handle relative URLs by prepending base domain
- Extract background-image URL from style attribute if data-lazy is empty
- Parse listing count from .srp-list-count element
- Handle pagination (appears to use button/link based navigation)
